d: An anthropomorphic sheep with a slender build and a head featuring curly, cream-white wool and matching cream-white fur on the face. The eyes are dark, glossy, and wide-set, conveying a blank expression. The outfit consists of a muted olive-green blazer with a thin black belt, a black mini-skirt, and black open-toe heels, featuring a large red heart-shaped cutout on the chest that reveals a book. Accessories include a black choker, a small cassette player clipped to the waist with wired headphones worn over the ears, and a vintage suitcase held in the hand. BODY COLOR: cream-white
